name: mcp-fairrent
display_name: HUD Fair Market Rents and Income Limits
description: HUD housing data: Fair Market Rents, Section 8 income limits, LIHTC/MTSP bands, computed affordability verdicts, and the USPS ZIP crosswalk both ways.
long_description:
Answers "is this rent affordable here, and who qualifies for help?" from HUD's published tables rather than from recall. Fair Market Rents by bedroom count for an area or a whole state, the 30/50/80% AMI income limits by household size, the LIHTC/MTSP bands tax-credit buildings use, and the USPS crosswalk that turns a ZIP into the right HUD area and back. affordability_check does the arithmetic server-side and returns the underlying numbers and table year, so an answer can be cited.

Needs a free HUD USER API token: one-screen signup at https://www.huduser.gov/portal/dataset/fmr-api.html. Read-only; it sends nothing to HUD but the area you ask about.

tools.name: fmr_lookup
tools.description: Fair Market Rent for an area, by bedroom count (efficiency through 4BR).

tools.name: income_limits
tools.description: The 30% / 50% / 80% AMI income thresholds for an area; the 50% line is the usual Section 8 voucher cutoff.

tools.name: affordability_check
tools.description: How far a rent sits above or below FMR, and which income bands a household qualifies under, computed server-side with the numbers and table year behind each verdict.

tools.name: zip_crosswalk
tools.description: Map a ZIP to the county, tract, CBSA, CBSA division, congressional district, or county subdivision it sits in.

tools.name: list_counties
tools.description: Counties (and, in New England, towns) in a state with their HUD entity ids.

tools.name: list_metro_areas
tools.description: HUD metro areas (CBSAs) with their codes.

tools.name: mtsp_income_limits
tools.description: The LIHTC tax-credit income bands at 20-80% AMI plus the HERA special bands.

tools.name: state_fmr_overview
tools.description: Every county's and metro's FMRs for a whole state in one call.

tools.name: geo_to_zips
tools.description: The reverse crosswalk: every ZIP inside a county, tract, metro, CBSA division, congressional district, or county subdivision.

api_token.title: HUD USER API token
api_token.description: Required by every tool. Free, one-screen signup at https://www.huduser.gov/portal/dataset/fmr-api.html
